title: Lewis's prayer and Guesnon's spirit-guided solo; giving the talent back
summary: Prompted by Lewis's habit of praying, Guesnon tells of a solo he cannot repeat on a Kid Thomas record, says talent is God's gift, and says he is giving it back.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
